summary: Static React+Vite+Tailwind frontend, no DB/API layers needed. Chain depth per feature is shallow: most features are UI-only (component -> integration into page), no backend/state-management chain required beyond React Router.

Typed style/category config powering all preview cards — pure data, no component yet
Shell chrome (header/nav/bg) is a component that must then be wired into routing
PreviewFrame + StylePreviewCard + StyleInfoPanel built then wired into first category page to validate pattern before mass rollout
Reuses validated generic preview mechanism — just data wiring across 7 pages, no new component logic
12 structurally distinct components (glitchcore, pixel art, layout keywords, etc.) each need bespoke markup/CSS then wiring into their page
Depends on all category routes existing
Manual WCAG AA contrast pass + responsive check across all completed cards — audit only, no new components

revisions.reason: Earth (via /agent-team-swe re-invocation) requested 2 small polish fixes after v2 shipped: (1) outer preview-card wrapper (bg/shadow only) should respond to dark mode — demo content itself stays untouched, confirmed via AskUserQuestion this is scoped to StylePreviewCard + override components' outer card div, NOT PreviewFrame or demo internals; (2) shadow-clay's white highlight (rgba(255,255,255,0.7)) is too intense against a dark shell background and needs reduced intensity in dark mode. Both are small, well-scoped CSS/JSX-class-only changes — no new components, no new data, so this does not need the full T12-style multi-task chain.

newFeatureChains.reason: shadow-clay/-sm/-inset tokens are static @theme CSS vars — Tailwind v4 can't make a single utility class conditionally dark via @theme alone, so this needs a .dark scope override block in index.css redefining the --shadow-clay* custom properties with reduced white-highlight alpha. Pure CSS, no component logic.

Add dark: variants to the outer card div's bg/shadow classes across StylePreviewCard.tsx and every components/overrides/*.tsx file that has its own outer card wrapper (the layout-keyword and custom demos each define their own outer card since they don't go through StylePreviewCard) — mechanical, repeated small edit, no new logic. Depends on dark-shadow-tokens landing first so the shadow-clay utility itself is already dark-aware before cards start using dark:shadow-clay.
